budget_items.topic: Lunenburg Water District financing for new garage
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The water district's consensus was to apply for a thirty-year note through the USDA loan program at a stated interest range.
budget_items.quote: the consensus was to apply for a thirty year note with interest rate of between 2.185% and 3.125% through the usda loan program.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed four warrants: accounts payable, MS/HS project, payroll, and deductions.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $347,080.85; a ms/hs project warrant in the amount of $1,117,316.51

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Members discussed leasing versus purchasing, use of the school contingency fund, and savings from the project; no dollar figures were printed.
budget_items.quote: there were some questions about leasing versus purchasing, use of the contingency fund from the school to do it and concerns about aesthetics.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The School Building Committee authorized change orders totaling $31,842.
budget_items.quote: the committee authorized some change orders in the total amount of $31,842.

budget_items.topic: School building project supplemental heating units
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Of the change orders, $15,834 provides supplemental heating units in one open space.
budget_items.quote: $15,834 of that provides supplemental heating units in one of the open spaces.

budget_items.topic: School building project locker room convectors relocation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Relocating two convectors in the locker rooms to meet ADA compliance cost $3,680.
budget_items.quote: two convectors in the locker rooms had to be relocated because they stuck out too far to be ada compliant, costing $3,680.

budget_items.topic: School building project auditorium flooring change
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Changing the control booth flooring from carpeting to vinyl composite tile cost $1,401.
budget_items.quote: there was a flooring change in the control booth in the auditorium electrical room from carpeting to vinyl composite tile flooring which reduces static electricity build up. this cost $1,401.

budget_items.topic: School building project concessions boulder wall regrading
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The concessions-area boulder wall change and regrading cost $10,039.
budget_items.quote: the area will be regraded at a cost of $10,039.

budget_items.topic: School building project pending change requests
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Other change requests amounting to $95,000 are pending and not known whether they will go forward.
budget_items.quote: there are some other change requests amounting to $95,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A little less than $4 million remains in the contingency fund.
budget_items.quote: right now there is a little less than $4 million remaining in the contingency fund.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bids for a three-year asphalt contract were received; the low bidder's price is lower than the current contract. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: bids for a three year contract were received for the purchase of asphalt. the low bidder was p.j. keating and the price is lower than the current contract.
